Latest Activity.note: A regional broadcaster, Saarländischer Rundfunk, reported on 7 October 2025 that STEAG told it the planning phase for a new gas engine power plant at Fenne is under way. The company is in talks with the grid operator Creos about a gas connection. The plant is planned at 150 MW. The report also says that not all conditions are settled yet.

Status Detail.value: Planning phase under way as of October 2025. Gas connection talks with the grid operator are in progress. Framework conditions are not yet settled.
Status Detail.note: This is taken from the Saarländischer Rundfunk report of 7 October 2025. It does not say a permit has been applied for or that construction has started, so the status stays announced.
